parsing_res_list.block_content: $ \underline{\mathrm{Lemma}} $ A.16 Assume Conditions (C1), (C5), (C6). Let  $ \delta = D/\xi $. Let  $ \Theta^l \in \bar{\mathbb{B}}_{\Theta}(D) $, and  $ \mathbf{b}^l, l = 1, \ldots N_{\Theta}(\delta) $ be  $ \delta $-covering of  $ \bar{\mathbb{B}}_{\Theta}(D) $ in Frobenius norm. Assume

$$ \begin{array}{r l}&{\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{A})^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{F}_{\Theta}(\mathbf{X},\mathbf{Y}|\widetilde{\Theta},\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\beta}})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{B})}\\ {=}&{(m n)^{-1}\left(\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n}\displaystyle\sum_{j=1}^{m}\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{A})^{\mathrm{T}}R_{i j}[H_{2}(Y_{i j},\mathbf{X}_{i j}|\widetilde{\Theta},\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\beta}})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})^{\mathrm{T}}\right.}\\ &{\left.-E\{H_{2}(Y_{i j},\mathbf{X}_{i j}|\widetilde{\Theta},\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\beta}})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})^{\mathrm{T}}|Y_{i j}\}\right.}\\ &{+E\{S_{2}^{2}(Y_{i j},\mathbf{X}_{i j},\widetilde{\Theta},\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\beta}})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})^{\mathrm{T}}|Y_{i j}\}-E\{S_{2}(Y_{i j},\mathbf{X}_{i j}|\widetilde{\Theta},\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\beta}})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})|Y_{i j}\}^{\otimes2}]\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{B})\Biggr).}\end{array} $$
Then there are positive constants  $ c_{d2}, c_{d3} $ such that

$$ \begin{array}{r l}&{|\mathrm{v e c}(\boldsymbol{\Theta})^{k^{\mathrm{T}}}R_{i j}[H_{2}(Y_{i j},\mathbf{X}_{i j}|\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\Theta}},\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\beta}})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})^{\mathrm{T}}-E\{H_{2}(Y_{i j},\mathbf{X}|\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\Theta}},\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\beta}})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})^{\mathrm{T}}|Y_{i j}\}}\\ &{+E\{S_{2}^{2}(Y_{i j},\mathbf{X}|\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\Theta}},\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\beta}})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})^{\mathrm{T}}|Y_{i j}\}-E\{S_{2}(Y_{i j},\mathbf{X}|\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\Theta}},\widetilde{\boldsymbol{\beta}})\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})|Y_{i j}\}^{\otimes2}]\mathrm{v e c}(\boldsymbol{\Theta})^{k}|}\\ {\leq}&{\{2d_{H_{2}}\|\boldsymbol{\Theta}^{k}\|_{F}\|\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})\|_{2}\|\boldsymbol{\Theta}^{k}\|_{\operatorname*{m a x}}\|\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})\|_{1}}\\ &{+2d_{S_{2}}^{2}\|\boldsymbol{\Theta}^{k}\|_{F}\|\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})\|_{2}\|\boldsymbol{\Theta}^{k}\|_{\operatorname*{m a x}}\|\mathrm{v e c}(\mathbf{z}_{i j})\|_{1}\}}\\ {=}&{2(d_{H_{2}}+d_{S_{2}}^{2})a D}\end{array} $$
